name: DATU Signet Personal Vault
description: Signet Personal Vault (SPV) for any namespace — land titles, driver licences, procurement bids, permits. Sign consent in any role, verify records from any node, and read only the fields sealed to you. Keys stay in your local Signet service (paired with a token).

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:*
